speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) why is "treatment of self-inflicted injuries or injuries resulting from attempted suicide" not covered under MediShield Life; and (b) whether the Ministry will consider removing this from the standard exclusions under MediShield Life.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Nonetheless, exceptions can be considered where such injuries might arise from mental illnesses.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
text: Would the Senior Minister of State Edwin Tong please share if there will be a review at least to see if we can include such injuries?
